sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Selection write through the Controller session: replace (set_selection) and extend (add_to_selection) with canonical-id, existence and effective permission checks in the host, then scene-root validation by the Controller before commit. A selection-only command produces no transaction or Undo entry; a bad id refuses the whole command and keeps the previous selection.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Only replace and add are exposed; subobject refs, pick queries, window/crossing selection and drag remain at their owners.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Complete add/remove/toggle for persistent object IDs: toggle removes a selected id and joins an unselected one; remove is idempotent and needs only a canonical UUID; joining still requires a live, selectable root validated against the published scene before commit. Selection remains outside document state.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Object-root selection only; subobject refs, pick queries, window/crossing and drag remain at their owners.
